name: Husein Zolkepli
bio: Husein Zolkepli is co-founder and CTO of Mesolitica, a Malaysian company building language and speech models for Malaysian languages. Zolkepli is first author of the 2024 MaLLaM paper describing Malaysia-focused language models of 1.1B to 5B parameters, and publishes many open models and datasets on Hugging Face.
known_for: Open Malaysian speech and text datasets
